intro: Friday the 13th, quiet but quality! Our guy kept it lean today: a two-word quote-post on X, some 20-year-veteran plumbing wisdom for the SPY board overthinkers, plus one Microsoft-outage leftover from Thursday that we couldn't leave behind.

items.caption: A public service for every overthinker on the SPY board: a rubber P trap, 20 years under the sink, still doing fine. Some things just hold. Diamond hands, but make it plumbing.
items.quote: $SPY For all you overthinkers out there, I’ve had a rubber P trap under the sink for about 20 years and it’s doing fine.

items.caption: Someone posts "Thiefff" and our guy names the crime in two words: "Deli tax." Efficiency. Precision. Poetry.
Bonus from Thursday's outage saga: tagging $SPY and $MSFT with a knowing "many such cases going forward." The catchphrase returns, now with a forecast!
